purpose: Customer profile center with manual login CTA, verified profile details, customer ID, mapped identity status, and placed order history.
ownedConcepts: Sign out and switch account actions
businessRules: Signed-out customers can continue browsing without auth; order placement remains gated at confirm-and-pay.
Signed-in customer truth comes from /api/customer-profile and /api/customer-orders using the HTTP-only backend session cookie.
Order summaries are keyed by authenticated customerId so email and phone identities mapped to the same customer show the same placed orders.
React state caches order summaries by customerId to avoid showing another customer's order history after account switching.
Account action cards must use distinct semantic icons: checkout uses ShoppingBag, wishlist uses Heart, order support uses PackageCheck, and general support uses Headset.
